change_summary: Initial baseline agent and SWE-bench runner before unified trace improvements.
finding: The harness completed one SWE-bench Verified evaluation, but the agent produced an empty patch after repeated invalid action parsing failures. Evidence: artifacts/runs/20260508-162348-astropy__astropy-12907/result.json and agent_events.jsonl.
hypothesis: Baseline LangChain JSON-action loop can produce an evaluable SWE-bench patch with traces.
next_action: Improve action parsing and rerun the same task.
pareto_assessment: Baseline observation only; not a candidate for merge.

change_summary: Added extraction of valid JSON actions from noisy model output and optimized repository checkout with filtered fetch.
finding: The agent executed tool actions after parser improvement, but repeated reproduction-script writes and still produced an empty patch. Evidence: artifacts/runs/20260508-163201-astropy__astropy-12907/trace.jsonl and result.json.
hypothesis: If valid JSON can be extracted from noisy model responses, invalid action count drops and the agent reaches tool execution earlier.
next_action: Test a patch-focused loop or anti-repetition control on a hypothesis branch.
pareto_assessment: Improves failure class and invalid action count, but not solve rate or wall time. Keep as infrastructure progress.

change_summary: Added canonical unified trace.jsonl timeline while preserving secondary trace slices.
finding: A one-iteration run produced a complete unified timeline with run, task, agent, LLM, tool, patch, prediction, and evaluation events. The trace initially included hidden SWE-bench fields, which required a follow-up correction. Evidence: artifacts/runs/20260508-164343-astropy__astropy-12907/trace.jsonl.
hypothesis: If all events are written to a single trace, meta-agent analysis becomes self-contained and less error-prone.
next_action: Remove hidden SWE-bench fields from task artifacts and traces.
pareto_assessment: Infrastructure improvement only; one-iteration run is not solve-rate comparable.

change_summary: Removed hidden SWE-bench fields from task.json and trace task_loaded events; kept unified trace as the canonical run artifact.
finding: The run produced a complete trace without gold patch, test_patch, FAIL_TO_PASS, or PASS_TO_PASS in public task artifacts. It still produced no patch because it was a one-iteration observability check. Evidence: artifacts/runs/20260508-164503-astropy__astropy-12907/trace.jsonl and result.json.
hypothesis: If hidden benchmark fields are removed from public artifacts, future meta-analysis remains useful without leaking answers to the evolving agent.
next_action: Start the next behavior-changing hypothesis from main on hyp/<date>-<slug>. Candidate: require tracked source diff before finish and discourage repeated reproduction writes.
pareto_assessment: Safety fix dominates on leakage risk; wall time is not comparable because clone/model latency varied.
